rules.message: data-hx-include must point at the filter form whose pairs the view captures (e.g. #filters).
The save response is the views strip — point data-hx-target at the strip region, not at the save form itself.
data-hx-target (the strip region) must point at an element in the document. (warn: fragments may target elements elsewhere on the page)
Keep method="post" + action on the save form so saving works without JavaScript.
Label the name input — placeholder text is not a label.
